stories.title: Update: Amar Ujala says Jamia offline classes, library and canteen reopen Monday 9 November, a day before the date in IANS report
stories.body: Amar Ujala reported on Saturday 31 October that Jamia Millia Islamia will resume offline classes on Monday 9 November, after Diwali, and reopen its library and canteen the same day, citing an unnamed university official. The paper says campus activities are to return to normal and that cleanup had begun. The report follows the end of the 18-day student protest. This is a day earlier than the Tuesday 10 November date in an IANS report of Friday 30 October, which quoted the registrar's order. The Amar Ujala report cites no formal order and does not mention hostels or exams.
stories.check: NEEDS CHECK: Amar Ujala (31 Oct, unnamed official) says 9 November; IANS (30 Oct, quoting the registrar's order) says 10 November; a 28 October order reported by PTI had online classes until 24 November. The order itself was not seen and no Jamia press release after 6179 (30 Oct) was found. Confirm the current notice, and the hostel position, with Jamia.
